==Recent Senate Elections==
As an Imperial territory, {{{Territory}}} {{{Controlled|is}}} represented by a [[senator]] elected in the {{{Season}}}. {{#lst:Archive:All_Election_Results|{{{1}}}_election}} The table to the right shows the citizens who have been elected to hold {{{2|this title}}} in the years since [[Empress Britta]] died.
